I need to find two specific papers about fast radio bursts (FRBs):

1. A paper from March 2021 on arXiv about multiwavelength observations of fast radio bursts that has a diagram of an X-ray time profile. This is likely about FRB 121102 or another FRB with simultaneous X-ray observations.

Please:

- Search arXiv for papers from July 2020 by similar authors about FRBs with burst diagrams
- Find the specific time spans shown in the X-ray time profile diagrams from both papers

python3 -c "
import urllib.request
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

# Search arXiv API for March 2021 papers about multiwavelength FRB observations
url = 'http://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query=all:multiwavelength+AND+all:fast+radio+burst+AND+submittedDate:[202103010000+TO+202103312359]&max_results=10&sortBy=submittedDate&sortOrder=descending'
try:
    data = urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=30).read()
    root = ET.fromstring(data)
    ns = {'atom': 'http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom', 'arxiv': 'http://arxiv.org/schemas/atom'}
    for entry in root.findall('atom:entry', ns):
        title = entry.find('atom:title', ns).text.strip()
        published = entry.find('atom:published', ns).text
        authors = [a.find('atom:name', ns).text for a in entry.findall('atom:author', ns)]
        arxiv_id = entry.find('atom:id', ns).text.split('/abs/')[-1]
        print(f'ID: {arxiv_id}')
        print(f'Title: {title}')
        print(f'Published: {published}')
        print(f'Authors: {authors[:3]}...')
        print()
except Exception as e:
    print(f'Error: {e}')
" 2>&1
